answer: A workable defense is an audit that lets verifiers wander: roaming agents sample transactions at random and check each identity against a shared atlas of verified work history. An honest agent's record is public and consistent; a fake one must forge a whole history for every sock puppet, and forging one entry costs more than the fraud it enables. Ivory-tower trust is replaced by earned proof: each fake identity pays the full verification cost, so mass fakery scales the attacker's bill, not their profit.
